decisions.formed_vs_insert: Unknown after exact-model exploded-diagram review. Neck/opening is represented within cover service assembly; absence of a separate service callout does not prove integral forming.
decisions.baffle_presence_and_geometry: Unknown after viewed exact-model engine, PCV, rocker and lubrication figures; none gives an oil-fill underside section or baffle attachment.
decisions.illustrative_candidate_limit: A parameter-matched threaded neck continuously attached to cover can be mechanically coherent. It remains an educational geometry assumption, not production/factory acceptance.
decisions.recommended_geometry_representation: Model female neck within valve-cover service assembly, with continuous load path. Manufacturing joint unresolved; no separately sourced insert part exists in reviewed figure.

candidate_variants.basis: Current cap 31.24 mm major / 4.5 mm pitch retained only as declared assumptions/replacement comparison; mate from same complete parameter set.

required_measurements: Identified cover engineering code and cap markings
Cap-off opening top/grazing views and cover underside with in-plane scale
Neck-to-cover seam/flange/weld or continuous formed wall evidence
Seal-land height from roof, OD/ID/width and wall thickness
Thread major/minor, pitch/lead, starts, handedness, profile and axial endpoints
Cap installed insertion depth, engaged span and angular phase
Seal free/compressed size and seat/groove details
Any oil-fill baffle attachment, offset, drain openings and rocker clearance
required_candidate_gates: Connected material/load path from female flank to cover
Engagement and straight-pull restraint plus collision-free screw release; oversized-bore negative control
Finite seal seat/contact with declared compression, without pressure/leak guarantee
Cap and new neck/baffle versus rocker full sampled travel and affected static neighbors
Browser integration and independent review, preserving factory evidence gap
